user_prompt:
method count_upper(s: string) returns (count: int)
    requires s != null
    ensures count >= 0
    ensures count == |{ i | i in 0 .. s.Length | i % 2 == 0 && IsUpperVowel(s[i]) }| // count of uppercase vowels at even indices

// Helper function to determine if a character is an uppercase vowel
method IsUpperVowel(c: char) returns (result: bool)
    ensures result == (c == 'A' || c == 'E' || c == 'I' || c == 'O' || c == 'U')
